scope: Targeted standing-module review from existing eight-book distillation. Only frameworks and voice changed. No new behavioral tests or empirical admission.

counting_rules.items: Count separately described conceptual distinctions, moves, application situations and located evidence passages in retained modules. Same passage revisited in a module counts once; connected but separate episodes can share an F record. Counts do not measure independent corroboration.
counting_rules.apparatus: Named concepts and explicitly labelled conceptual distinctions are assigned a home here; labels are editorial where the runtime says so. This adapts the legacy frameworks-table column to the current prose architecture.
counting_rules.moves: Retained source-supported moves, not empirically admitted transfer survivors. All missing transfer and discrimination scores remain null.
counting_rules.registers: Editorial occasions already represented in voice and the relevant source genres, not measured statistical families. Planning targets price this declared range; sensitivity to a single family is reported.
counting_rules.mass: Audited explicit source spans within a filtered primary-source pool; missing chapter-only spans are omitted, not guessed. Exact counts and filters are recorded separately.
counting_rules.no_fitting: Default formula coefficients are unchanged. No input was optimized to make actual sizes pass. Deviations remain visible.
